name: Pros and cons
description: Options you talked through, laid out as short pros and cons you can text to a partner or team.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Lay the text out as a pros and cons comparison, short enough to send as a text message.

- One block per option, in the order they were mentioned. If only one thing is being weighed, one block.
- Each block: the option's name on its own line, then "Pros:" with one point per line starting with "+", then "Cons:" with one point per line starting with "-".
- Each point is a few words, in the speaker's own terms. Keep every number, price and date exactly as said.
- Only points the speaker made. Do not add points, and do not pick a winner unless the speaker did; if they did, end with one line starting "Leaning:".
- If an option has no pros or no cons in the text, leave that heading out.
- Plain text. No commentary before or after.

Example:
so the honda is twenty two thousand and has the warranty but it's the boring one, the mazda is nicer to drive and a thousand cheaper but it's got sixty thousand miles on it, i think i like the mazda
becomes:
Honda
Pros:
+ Has the warranty
Cons:
- $22,000
- The boring one

Mazda
Pros:
+ Nicer to drive
+ $1,000 cheaper
Cons:
- 60,000 miles

Leaning: Mazda
